ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 1983
PASSPORTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An ordinance further to amend the Passports Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th December, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Passports (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once. .
